summary: A Quote subscription on the NIFTY index: the QUOTE packet gives an index frame with the change against the previous close; after Angel drops the socket the subscription is sent again on the new connection, with the same headers.

notes: price_change 50.5 = 24350.5 - 24300.0, percent 0.21 (rounded to 2 places); after the reconnect 60.0 and 0.25.

deviations.reason: An index has no trades or book: the web sends the packet's zero last quantity for it, the desktop leaves it out, as the lead decided for values the stream does not carry (Kotak index volume and totals; docs: leave out).

An index has no trades or book: the web sends the packet's zero last trade quantity for it, the desktop leaves it out, as the lead decided for values the stream does not carry (Kotak index volume and totals; docs: leave out).

An index has no trades or book: the web sends the packet's zero average price for it, the desktop leaves it out, as the lead decided for values the stream does not carry (Kotak index volume and totals; docs: leave out).

An index has no trades or book: the web sends the packet's zero total buy quantity for it, the desktop leaves it out, as the lead decided for values the stream does not carry (Kotak index volume and totals; docs: leave out).

An index has no trades or book: the web sends the packet's zero total sell quantity for it, the desktop leaves it out, as the lead decided for values the stream does not carry (Kotak index volume and totals; docs: leave out).

The desktop's index frames add price_change and price_change_percent. The web's Angel adapter sends no change for an index. Lead ruling 2026-11-09: price_change and price_change_percent are not docs keys, so an index frame carries them only as each broker's web adapter sends them; the desktop follows the adapter (lane wire dialect, phase B).
